body_lead: Bhubaneswar: The Odisha Higher Education Department on Saturday signed Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs) with CSRBOX, Nandi Foundation and Odisha Knowledge Corporation Limited (OKCL) to strengthen skill development, artificial intelligence (AI) education, employability and entrepreneurship among students and faculty members across the State.
